model_scope: Independent binary-fact repertoire with cultural testimony; no demography, fitness weighting, selection, cooperation, social norms, or combinatorial reasoning.

common_random_numbers.description: Within each D/seed block, all p, d, adult-policy, and environment comparisons reuse context choices, teacher choices, cue uniforms, acceptance uniforms, override uniforms, tie draws, and audit uniforms. Cue correctness is nested across p. State-dependent audit eligibility and endogenous teacher signs still differ by policy.

metric_definitions.adult_accuracy: Mean held-belief correctness across organisms and contexts; b=0 scores 0.5.
metric_definitions.private_accuracy: Mean private-ledger correctness across organisms and contexts; u=0 scores 0.5.
metric_definitions.held_coverage: Fraction of organism-context held scores with b nonzero.
metric_definitions.private_coverage: Fraction of organism-context private scores with u nonzero.
metric_definitions.knowledge_heterogeneity: Mean across contexts of the within-cohort variance in correctness scores 0, 0.5, or 1.
metric_definitions.teacher_accuracy: Prior-generation held accuracy scored against truth at the current generation; this drops immediately at a true-state shock.
metric_definitions.teacher_accuracy_expressed: Accuracy among nonzero prior-generation held signs only.
metric_definitions.child_conflict_override_rate: Overrides divided by encounters where a nonzero adult sign conflicts with the child's private action; u=0 private actions use a pre-generated fair tie break.
metric_definitions.recovery_fraction_end: (end accuracy - shock accuracy)/(pre-shock mean accuracy - shock accuracy), reported only when the initial shock loss is positive.
metric_definitions.recovery_generation_90: First shock-or-later generation reaching 90% of the lost pre-shock held accuracy.

matched_cue_quality.description: Common uniform cue draws give nested correct-cue sets as p increases.

matched_environment_pre_shock.description: Stable and quarter-flip runs are exactly paired through generation 11.

private_ledger_independent_of_d_when_que.description: Frozen and retained-update private ledgers are identical across d under common private draws; audit is excluded because its query eligibility depends on b.
